summary: Feed s131_double is degraded: 20.5% duplicates (798/3889) and 14.0% truncated frames sliced to 128 bytes (543/3889). Duplicates waste NDR resources and skew detection; truncation prevents full-payload inspection required by this NDR.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is delivering duplicate copies of the same packets - typically from aggregating two SPAN/mirror ports or both directions of a TAP without deduplication. 20.5% exceeds 5% threshold.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR wastes CPU/storage processing same packet twice, inflates flow/connection counts, corrupts analytics and can cause false positives and missed detections.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication to drop duplicate packets before the 10G NDR tool port; eliminates 20% overhead and restores accurate detection.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker slicing/snaplen is configured to ~128 bytes, cutting frames short. 543 of 3889 frames truncated while NDR profile needs_full_payload=true.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR cannot inspect full payload beyond L2-L4 headers; signatures, file extraction, and anomaly detection fail on truncated flows, severely reducing detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: NDR requires full payload up to 9216B per tool profile; disable slicing or set snaplen to max frame size to deliver complete packets for inspection.
